summary: Organizes the core processing pipelines of the compiler, encapsulating execution logic, prompts, rendering utilities, and state management for tasks such as docstring updates, package analysis, translation, and documentation generation.
responsibilities: Implement specialized processing pipelines for generating directory concepts, updating docstrings, processing documents, managing LLM context, analyzing package concepts, generating README documentation, and translating content.
relationships: The compiler pipelines coordinate specialized sub-pipelines for directory concepts, docstring updates, document processing, LLM context management, package concepts, README generation, and content translation.
design_decisions: Organizes specialized processing pipelines into distinct sub-modules for generation, documentation, and translation tasks.
Employs modular execution logic, prompt providers, and rendering utilities across pipeline implementations.
